why_hard: The family history includes a father with an MI at 52 and CABG, a brother with Brugada syndrome who has an ICD, and the patient's own 2014 PCI. None of these is recent or the patient's rhythm diagnosis.

pages.title: History and physical
lines: - Anterior STEMI 03/2014 -> PCI/DES to prox LAD 03/11/2014
FHx: Father - MI at 52, CABG at 60, died 71. Mother - DM2, d. 84. Brother (63) - Brugada syndrome, has ICD since 2019. Sister healthy.
SHx: retired electrician. Lives w/ wife. EtOH rare.
ROS: + DOE (1-2 blocks), - CP, - syncope, - palpitations, - orthopnea.
Exam: BP 118/70, HR 66. Mild expiratory wheeze. No edema.

A/P: ICM, NYHA class II, LVEF 29% (TTE 09/03). No ACS or repeat revascularization since 2014. Brugada evaluation completed given brother's dx (see EP note) - negative. Refer for primary prevention ICD.

pages.title: Echocardiogram report
lines: Anterior, anteroseptal and apical akinesis, thinned/scarred.
Impression: Severe ischemic LV dysfunction, LVEF 29%.

pages.title: EP note - Brugada evaluation
lines: Indication: brother with Brugada syndrome; screen pt before device planning
Baseline ECG with high precordial leads (V1-V2 at 2nd/3rd ICS): no type 1 pattern.
Procainamide 10 mg/kg IV: no coved ST elevation, no type 1 pattern. QRS 104 -> 116.
Conclusion: patient does not have Brugada syndrome. ICD indication, if any, is based on his ischemic cardiomyopathy.

pages.title: Shared decision making note
lines: SDM VISIT - ICD - Meridian Valley Device Clinic
Decision aid: evidence-based ICD decision aid, reviewed (paper + video).
Pt has seen his brother's device and shocks; we separated his brother's situation (inherited rhythm disorder) from his own (scar-related risk).

pages.title: Pre-admission plan
lines: Factors: COPD w/ wheeze, risk of post-sedation bronchospasm/hypoxia; CKD 3a w/ contrast; DM2.
Exclusions: cognitively intact; no illness limiting survival <1 yr; no AF; clinically stable. None.

comorbidities.why: Patient's own conditions on the pre-admission plan. The father's MI and the brother's Brugada are family history, not the patient's comorbidities.

cardiomyopathy_type.why: Ischemic cardiomyopathy after 2014 anterior STEMI. Brugada was ruled out by procainamide challenge (page 4), so the request does not rest on an inherited rhythm disorder.

recent_mi_revasc.why: Patient's MI and PCI were 03/2014; 'No ACS or repeat revascularization since 2014.' The father's MI at 52 is family history.

optimal_medical_therapy_months.why: Carvedilol and ACEi since 2014-03-13. Not decisive (ischemic).

shared_decision_making.why: SDM 09/30/2026 with an evidence-based decision aid.

action_reasoning: Ischemic, LVEF 29% by echo, NYHA II, last MI and PCI in 2014, SDM done, no limiting condition, 2 midnights with COPD, CKD and DM. Family history does not change any rule. Approve.
